items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: the reason I know is Sue was booking him in South America

ctx.x: That's right. And I worked five nights, they got paid five nights pro rata. If I played seven nights, they'd make over $1,000. I didn't want to work like that. I

worked where you take off and visit, and see who you are. You might be in Spain and might want to see a bullfight. Lionel Hampton -- the reason I know is Sue was booking him in South America, where I've been already.
